newsitem.title: DUBAI: U.N. and Iran raise $440,000 for quake victims.
newsitem.headline: U.N. and Iran raise $440,000 for quake victims.

text.p: The United Nations has helped raise $440,000 for the victims of two strong earthquakes in Iran this month which killed 86 people and injured hundreds, the U.N. Information Centre in Tehran said on Sunday.

The quakes, which jolted Iran's northeastern Khorasan province on February 5 with a force of 6.1 and 5.4 on the Richter scale, were followed by more than 600 aftershocks, inflicting damage to a vast area, the centre said.
"Over 100 villages suffered varying degrees of destruction, some (were) totally razed," it said in a statement. "Over 11,000 houses were damaged, forcing thousands to become homeless."
The centre said the funds were raised through joint efforts of the U.N. system in Iran and the Iranian authorities.
